title: Renal colic
stem: Cubicle 31. Ms Lau, 35, has severe colicky left loin pain radiating to the groin since this afternoon. BP 135/85, HR 90, temperature 36.8 °C. Take a history, then discuss investigations and management.

review.text: Imaging. Your notes use a KUB X-ray and bedside ultrasound. NICE recommends low-dose non-contrast CT KUB within 24 hours in adults (a KUB film misses many stones); ultrasound first in pregnancy and children.
Medical expulsive therapy. Your notes offer nifedipine or an alpha-blocker. Nifedipine is no longer used; give tamsulosin for distal ureteric stones under 10 mm.

notes:
Checked against NICE NG118 (Renal and ureteric stones, 2019), EAU Urolithiasis guideline (2024).

Imaging: urgent low-dose non-contrast CT KUB within 24 hours of presentation in adults (ultrasound first in pregnancy and children). Analgesia: NSAIDs (e.g. IM/PR diclofenac or IV/oral) first-line, then IV paracetamol, then opioids; no antispasmodics. Medical expulsive therapy: alpha-blocker (tamsulosin) for distal ureteric stones under 10 mm (EAU: most benefit 5–10 mm). Most stones under 5 mm pass spontaneously. Emergency referral: signs of infection with obstruction (obstructed infected kidney — urgent decompression by nephrostomy or stent; antibiotics), solitary kidney, bilateral obstruction, AKI, uncontrolled pain. Always exclude AAA in older patients with 'renal colic', and ectopic pregnancy in women.

Your notes use a KUB X-ray and bedside ultrasound, and nifedipine or alpha-blockers; NICE recommends non-contrast CT (KUB X-ray alone misses many stones) and alpha-blockers rather than nifedipine. Discharge advice (fluids, strain urine, return if fever) matches.

steps.label: History
steps.hint: Analgesia first, SOCRATES, urinary symptoms, fever, LMP/pregnancy, previous stones, PMH, drugs.

Start.tz: 我哋先俾止痛藥你，好唔好？

Pain.t: Where and what is the pain like?
Pain.rz: 左邊腰，一陣陣咁痛，痛到落大髀罅。成個人坐唔定。
Pain.r: Left loin, comes in waves, into my groin. Can't keep still.

Pain.tz: 小便有冇血、刺痛，或者特別頻密？
Pain.mark: Asks about haematuria and urinary symptoms

Other.t: Last period; could you be pregnant?
Other.tz: 你上次月經係幾時？有冇機會有咗？
Other.rz: 一個禮拜前嚟過；冇有咗。
Other.r: LMP a week ago; not pregnant.

Other.t: Previous stones; kidney disease; one kidney?
Other.tz: 以前有冇試過腎石？有冇腎病？係咪得一個腎？
Other.rz: 第一次。就我所知有兩個腎。
Other.r: First time. Two kidneys as far as I know.
Other.mark: Asks previous stones and solitary kidney

Other.tz: 你食緊咩藥？有冇敏感、哮喘或者胃潰瘍？

steps.label: Investigations
steps.hint: Urine dip and hCG, bloods, non-contrast CT KUB.

Imaging.r: 6 mm stone at the left vesicoureteric junction with mild hydronephrosis.
Misses radiolucent and small stones; CT is the first-line test (NICE).

steps.label: Explain
steps.hint: Stone diagnosis, NSAID, tamsulosin, fluids, strain urine, return advice, urology follow-up.

opts.t: A 6 mm stone near the bladder; most this size pass within weeks
opts.tz: 你有一粒六毫米嘅石，喺近膀胱嗰度；呢個大細嘅石，大部分幾個禮拜內會自己排出嚟。
opts.mark: Explains diagnosis and likelihood of passage

opts.t: NSAID analgesia; tamsulosin to help it pass; plenty of fluids; strain your urine and keep the stone
opts.tz: 我會開消炎止痛藥，同埋 tamsulosin 幫粒石排出嚟。飲多啲水，小便嗰陣用隔篩隔吓，搵到粒石就留低。

opts.t: Return at once with fever, rigors, vomiting, or uncontrolled pain; urology follow-up and repeat imaging
opts.tz: 如果發燒、發冷震、嘔，或者痛到止唔到，要即刻返嚟。之後泌尿科會跟進，再照一次。
我開 Buscopan 俾你止絞痛。
